params.text:
Successfully drafted and created a new marketing price rule for spring sale: 'Spring Sale 2025 - 20% Site-Wide Discount'. The rule offers a 20 percent discount site-wide for all customers with the following configuration:

1. Rule Information: Active rule with description 'Spring sale promotion offering 20% discount on all products for all customers'
2. Websites: Main Website (site-wide application)
3. Customer Groups: All groups (NOT LOGGED IN, General, Wholesale, Retailer) - applies to all customers
4. Coupon: No Coupon - discount automatically applied without requiring a coupon code
5. Dates: From March 1, 2025 to May 31, 2025 (spring season)
6. Conditions: No conditions specified - applies to all products
7. Actions: 20% discount (Percent of product price discount), unlimited quantity (Maximum Qty Discount is Applied To: 0)
8. Labels: Default labels configured

The rule is now active and will automatically apply a 20% discount to all products for all customers during the spring sale period from March 1 to May 31, 2025.
